hooks.command: root=$(pwd); file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in "$root"/*.ts) pnpm exec oxlint --disable-nested-config --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --fix "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm exec oxfmt --disable-nested-config --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; "$root"/*.json|"$root"/*.jsonc|"$root"/*.md|"$root"/*.yaml|"$root"/*.yml) pnpm exec oxfmt --disable-nested-config --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
